workingTitle: Protocol 001 — 38 letters to open an egg
logline: Valdemar presents, with engineering and pride, a 38-letter German egg topper; off camera, Sueli opens hers with a spoon.
arc: Maximum confidence: a German solution to an ignored problem
Technical name and demonstration of the mechanism (manufacturer's facts)
Escalation: three designers, an amethyst ball, contempt for scissors
Reality interrupts: spoon, two taps, 'Done.' Silence.
Fragile recovery (Christmas edition) and collapse: the manufacturer itself mentions additional cutlery
Last attempt to close the sale: price per letter. Stamp: awaiting need.
